title: 生物技术实验室安全入门（国内版）
source_doc: course/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/01_APB - Safety in the Biotechnology Laboratory.md
author_source: project/Animal & Plant Biotech Safety/01_APB - Safety in the Biotechnology Laboratory（国内版）/src.py

points.K1: 生物实验室为什么更要讲安全
points.K6: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
points.K13: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图
points.S2: 生物安全法规与风险评估
points.S5: 应急设施的位置与用法

shots.scene: 欣欣站在生物技术实验室门口，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at the door of a bright biotechnology teaching laboratory and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲生物技术实验室的安全入门。
overlay: 生物技术实验室安全入门

shots.scene: 护目镜、手套、生物危害标志、记录本四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: safety goggles, a pair of gloves, a biohazard warning sign and a blank notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 防护、规程、处置、记录，一样都不少。

shots.scene: 阿杰第一天进实验室，没穿实验服，伸手去拿培养皿
shots.prompt_en: On his first day, the young male student walks into the lab without a lab coat and reaches for a closed petri dish on the bench.
shots.narration: 阿杰第一次进实验室，伸手就想拿培养皿。

shots.scene: 小研拦住阿杰，递给他实验服和护目镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student gently stops the young male student and hands him a lab coat and safety goggles.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他：先穿戴好，再听规矩。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 生物实验室的安全，从哪儿学起？

shots.section_title: 生物实验室为什么更要讲安全
shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现细菌、植物细胞和DNA图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of bacteria, a plant cell and a DNA double helix.
shots.narration: 生物技术要和细胞、微生物打交道。
overlay: 生物实验室为什么更要讲安全

shots.section_title: 生物实验室为什么更要讲安全
shots.scene: 玻璃、试剂瓶、火焰图标旁多了一个生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of glassware, a reagent bottle and a flame, with a biohazard warning sign added beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 除了常见危险，还多了生物危害。

shots.section_title: 生物实验室为什么更要讲安全
shots.scene: 阿杰坐在桌前看课件，拿笔做笔记，旁边有暂停键图标
shots.prompt_en: The young male student sits at a desk watching a lesson on a blank screen and takes notes, with a pause button icon beside the screen.
shots.narration: 学的时候做笔记，没懂就暂停重看。

shots.scene: 一条平坦的道路，路边摆着锥桶，没有障碍
shots.prompt_en: A smooth clear path with orange traffic cones neatly lined along its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 安全，简单说就是远离事故。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着自己，身旁浮现同学和实验台图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at itself, with floating icons of classmates and a lab bench around it.
shots.narration: 它是每个人自己的责任。

shots.scene: 小研和阿杰并排在整洁的实验台前工作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the young male student work side by side at a tidy lab bench, both wearing lab coats and goggles.
shots.narration: 既护好自己，也护好同学和公共财物。

shots.scene: 阿杰照镜子，镜中是穿戴整齐的自己
shots.prompt_en: The young male student looks into a mirror and sees himself wearing a lab coat, goggles and gloves.
shots.narration: 对你安全负最大责任的，就是你自己。

shots.scene: 阿杰捧着空白操作规程，认真逐行阅读
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a blank procedure sheet and reads it carefully line by line.
shots.narration: 认真读规程，每一步都照着做。

shots.scene: 阿杰兴致勃勃地看小研示范新仪器
shots.prompt_en: The young male student watches with interest as the female graduate student demonstrates a new instrument.
shots.narration: 积极学习新方法，但不自作主张。

shots.scene: 阿杰按要求擦净台面、归位器材
shots.prompt_en: The young male student wipes the bench clean and returns equipment to its place.
shots.narration: 用完按要求清理，关心他人和财物。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现安全眼镜、实验围裙和一次性手套
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of safety glasses, a lab apron and disposable gloves.
shots.narration: 进实验室，始终穿戴个人防护装备。

shots.scene: 护目镜挡住飞溅液滴的示意图
shots.prompt_en: Diagram of safety goggles blocking small flying droplets. No people.
shots.narration: 防护既能减少受伤，

shots.scene: 戴手套的手拿培养皿，旁边细菌图标被挡在外面
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand holds a closed petri dish while small germ icons are blocked outside by a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 也能避免污染你的实验样品。

shots.scene: 小研对照空白清单，为不同实验选择防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks a blank checklist and picks protective items for different experiments.
shots.narration: 每项实验，都要自己选对、用对防护。

shots.scene: 玻璃器皿、试剂瓶、酒精灯火焰、剪刀四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: glassware, a reagent bottle, an alcohol lamp flame and a pair of scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室有四类常见危险。

shots.scene: 碎玻璃图标旁一只手被红叉划掉，旁边是镊子和簸箕
shots.prompt_en: Icon of broken glass with a bare hand crossed out by a red X, next to tongs and a small dustpan. No people.
shots.narration: 玻璃轻拿轻放，碎玻璃不能徒手碰。

shots.scene: 两个试剂瓶随意倒在一起的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of two reagent bottles being poured together randomly, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学品只按指示混合，不随手乱配。

shots.scene: 小研扎起长发、收好袖口，再靠近酒精灯
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ties back her long hair and tucks in her sleeves before approaching a lit alcohol lamp.
shots.narration: 靠近明火，扎好头发，收好宽松衣物。

shots.scene: 剪刀被当作撬棍撬盖子的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of scissors being used to pry open a lid, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工具只做规定用途。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身旁一本打开的空白规程
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside an open blank procedure book.
shots.narration: 守规程、慢一点，多数事故都能避免。

shots.section_title: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
shots.scene: 阿杰拿着用过的培养皿，站在几个不同颜色的空白垃圾桶前犹豫
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds a used closed petri dish and hesitates in front of several waste bins of different colors with blank labels.
shots.narration: 处置之前，先想清楚它是什么。
overlay: 废弃物先想清楚再处置

shots.section_title: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
shots.scene: 培养皿放进高压灭菌袋，旁边是高压灭菌器图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of used petri dishes inside an autoclave bag, next to an autoclave icon. No people.
shots.narration: 生物材料要先灭活，比如高压灭菌。

shots.section_title: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
shots.scene: 打开培养皿盖子的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand lifting the lid off a bacterial culture plate, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 没有指示，不要打开细菌培养物。

shots.section_title: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
shots.scene: 试剂瓶、天平图标和打勾的处理流程箭头
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a chemical waste bottle with an arrow to a neutral balance symbol and a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 化学废液按规定处理后再交收集。

shots.section_title: 废弃物先想清楚再处置
shots.scene: 王老师指着墙上空白的处置流程图
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator points at a blank disposal flow chart on the lab wall.
shots.narration: 具体怎么处置，听老师按本校规定讲。

shots.scene: 水槽边，小研刷洗玻璃器皿
shots.prompt_en: At a lab sink, the female graduate student, wearing gloves and goggles, scrubs glassware with a soft brush.
shots.narration: 器皿用完要彻底清洗，

shots.scene: 器皿浸在消毒液盆里的图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of glassware soaking in a tub of disinfecting solution. No people.
shots.narration: 再用消毒液处理。

shots.scene: 高压灭菌器图标，旁边是温度计和压力表图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of an autoclave with a thermometer icon and a pressure gauge icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有条件的，用高压灭菌器加热加压灭菌。

shots.scene: 欣欣在培养皿和灭菌器图标间画出箭头
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot draws an arrow between a petri dish icon and an autoclave icon.
shots.narration: 消毒灭菌，是生物技术的基本功。

shots.scene: 阿杰碰倒一瓶溶液，旁边一只烧杯碎了
shots.prompt_en: The young male student accidentally knocks over a bottle of clear solution, and a beaker beside it lies broken on the bench.
shots.narration: 意外会发生：溶液洒了，玻璃碎了。

shots.scene: 阿杰举手叫老师，王老师快步走来
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to call for help, and the safety administrator hurries over.
shots.narration: 所有溅洒和破损，都要报告老师。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿纸巾要擦的图标被打叉，旁边有冒泡的反应图标
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a hand wiping a spill with a paper towel crossed out with a red X, next to a bubbling reaction icon. No people.
shots.narration: 不要自己乱处理，可能引发有害反应。

shots.scene: 王老师和阿杰一起戴好手套准备清理
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator and the young male student put on gloves together, ready to clean up.
shots.narration: 按指示，大家一起安全地清理。

shots.scene: 三个编号框：举手、空白说明书、清理工具
shots.prompt_en: Three numbered boxes in a row: a raised hand, a blank safety data sheet, and cleanup tools. No people.
shots.narration: 处理溅洒，记住三步。

shots.scene: 小研翻开空白的安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student opens a blank safety data sheet binder at the bench.
shots.narration: 报告后，查安全技术说明书的清理方法。

shots.scene: 墙边的溅洒处理包被打开，里面有吸附材料和手套
shots.prompt_en: A spill kit box opened on a shelf, showing absorbent pads, gloves and a small scoop. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室备有溅洒处理包，要知道在哪。

shots.scene: 小研用钢笔在装订的记录本上书写
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student writes with a pen in a bound blank lab notebook.
shots.narration: 实验步骤和方案，都要仔细记录。

shots.scene: 记录本、重复箭头和奖章图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a notebook, a circular repeat arrow and a medal ribbon. No people.
shots.narration: 记下来，才能重复实验，甚至申请专利。

shots.scene: 放大镜照在记录本某一行上
shots.prompt_en: A magnifying glass hovering over one line of a blank notebook page. No people.
shots.narration: 出了事故，也能从记录里找原因。

shots.scene: 钢笔、整齐的页面和打勾图标；铅笔被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pen, a neat page and a green check; a pencil icon beside them is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 用笔写，写整洁，相关信息全记上。

shots.scene: 图表、曲线、表格、照片四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a bar chart, a line graph, a table and a photo. No people.
shots.narration: 数据可以用图、表、照片来记。

shots.scene: 阿杰翻看一本空白的记录本指南
shots.prompt_en: The young male student flips through a blank notebook guide booklet.
shots.narration: 拿不准时，查实验记录本指南。

shots.scene: 笔记本上三处荧光笔标记
shots.prompt_en: A notebook page with three highlighted lines in yellow marker. No people.
shots.narration: 学完划出三条要点，

shots.scene: 两个连接旧知识的灯泡图标和一个问号
shots.prompt_en: Two light bulb icons linked by a line to an open book, and a question mark icon. No people.
shots.narration: 连上两个旧知识，写下你的疑问。

shots.scene: 阿杰拿着笔记向王老师请教
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his notes and asks the safety administrator a question.
shots.narration: 疑问拿去和老师讨论，笔记留着备用。

shots.section_title: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图
shots.scene: 阿杰在空白纸上画实验室平面图
shots.prompt_en: The young male student draws a simple floor plan of the laboratory on a blank sheet.
shots.narration: 课堂活动：画一张实验室安全地图。
overlay: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图

shots.section_title: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图
shots.scene: 平面图上红、黄、绿三色圆点
shots.prompt_en: A simple lab floor plan with red, yellow and green colored dots marked at different spots. No people.
shots.narration: 标出安全设备、危险源和防护用品。

shots.section_title: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图
shots.scene: 阿杰对照地图找到灭火器并点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his map and points at a fire extinguisher on the wall, nodding.
shots.narration: 还要说清每样设备怎么用。

shots.section_title: 课堂活动：画一张安全地图
shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指，身后小研认真做实验
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up while the female graduate student works carefully in the background.
shots.narration: 认真守规，也是科研路上的好习惯。

shots.scene: 阿杰在电脑前参加安全考试，屏幕空白
shots.prompt_en: The young male student takes a safety test at a computer with a blank screen.
shots.narration: 进实验室前，先参加安全培训和考核。

shots.scene: 学校、学院、实验室三层图标
shots.prompt_en: A three-level stacked icon: a university building on top, a department building in the middle and a laboratory at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 学校、学院、实验室，三级管安全。

shots.scene: 老周站在实验室门口，查看门口的空白信息牌
shots.prompt_en: The older man stands at the lab door checking a blank laboratory information board.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，是安全第一责任人。

shots.section_title: 生物安全法规与风险评估
shots.scene: 法规书本图标和生物危害标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a closed law book and a biohazard warning sign side by side. No people.
shots.narration: 生物实验还要遵守国家生物安全法规。
overlay: 生物安全法规与风险评估

shots.section_title: 生物安全法规与风险评估
shots.scene: 小研在空白评估表上打勾
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student ticks items on a blank risk assessment form.
shots.narration: 实验前先做风险评估，

shots.section_title: 生物安全法规与风险评估
shots.scene: 几级台阶状的防护等级图标
shots.prompt_en: A staircase icon with several steps of increasing protection, each step with a shield. No people.
shots.narration: 在相应防护级别的实验室里做。

shots.scene: 穿实验服、长裤、包头鞋的人形图标；拖鞋短裤被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A person pictogram wearing a lab coat, long trousers and closed shoes; sandals and shorts icons beside it are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 穿实验服、长裤和不露脚面的鞋。

shots.scene: 水杯、食物、手机图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a drink cup, a sandwich and a mobile phone, each crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 实验室里不吃喝，不玩手机。

shots.scene: 小研摘下手套，在水槽洗手
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student removes her gloves and washes her hands at the lab sink.
shots.narration: 摘下手套后洗手，防护服不穿出实验区。

shots.scene: 感染性废物袋、锐器盒、化学废液桶三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons in a row: a biohazard waste bag, a sharps container and a chemical waste jug. No people.
shots.narration: 废弃物要分类收集。

shots.scene: 试剂瓶往水槽倒的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a bottle being poured into a sink drain, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 化学废液不能倒进下水道。

shots.scene: 王老师给收集桶贴上空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator sticks a blank label on a closed waste collection container.
shots.narration: 贴好标签，交学校统一处置。

shots.section_title: 应急设施的位置与用法
shots.scene: 洗眼器标志和洗眼器
shots.prompt_en: An eyewash sign above a lab eyewash station. No people.
shots.narration: 洗眼器在哪、怎么开，要先认清。
overlay: 应急设施的位置与用法

shots.section_title: 应急设施的位置与用法
shots.scene: 紧急喷淋标志和喷淋装置
shots.prompt_en: An emergency shower sign above an emergency safety shower. No people.
shots.narration: 大面积沾染，用紧急喷淋冲洗。

shots.section_title: 应急设施的位置与用法
shots.scene: 灭火器标志和墙上的灭火器、急救箱
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher sign above a wall-mounted fire extinguisher, with a first aid kit beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器、急救箱的位置也要记住。

shots.scene: 阿杰向老周报告，老周拿起电话
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports to the older man, who picks up the telephone.
shots.narration: 出了事，先报告实验室负责人。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a flame icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 着火拨119，有人受伤拨120。

shots.scene: 保卫处值班员接听电话，记录信息
shots.prompt_en: The security officer answers a phone call at the campus security desk and takes notes on a blank form.
shots.narration: 还要报告学院和保卫处。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现人形责任图标和防护用品
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a person with a shield and protective gear.
shots.narration: 安全靠自己，防护时时穿戴。

shots.scene: 玻璃、试剂、火焰、工具四个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green checks: glassware, a reagent bottle, a flame and scissors. No people.
shots.narration: 四类危险，按规程小心对待。

shots.scene: 灭菌器、废物袋和锐器盒图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an autoclave, a biohazard waste bag and a sharps container. No people.
shots.narration: 生物材料先灭活，废物分类处置。

shots.scene: 举手报告和空白说明书图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a raised hand and a blank safety data sheet. No people.
shots.narration: 意外先报告，再按程序清理。

shots.scene: 钢笔和记录本图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a pen and a bound notebook. No people.
shots.narration: 如实记录，每一步都写清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣在实验室门口挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera at the door of a tidy biotechnology laboratory.
shots.narration: 安全第一步，从今天迈出，下次见！
